title: Relational Geometry Forcing for World Action Models
title_zh: 面向世界动作模型的关系几何强制
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robot manipulation by jointly learning visual dynamics and executable actions. However, their video and action objectives do not explicitly constrain the 3D geometry that is crucial for precise manipulation. Recently, geometry-aware WAMs introduce depth or 4D prediction branches, whereas representation alignment methods supervise intermediate WAM features with pretrained 3D foundation models. Yet we find that such pointwise alignment benefits the video features but degrades action learning, since dense geometric feature targets overly restrict compact action features. To address this limitation, we propose Relational Geometry Forcing (RGF), which transfers geometric priors from a frozen 3D foundation model by aligning pairwise feature relations instead of pointwise features. Specifically, RGF applies three complementary relational objectives, where intra-frame and cross-view relations transfer scene geometry and multi-view correspondence to the video features, while action-temporal relations couple action dynamics to geometric scene evolution. Applied only during training, RGF requires no explicit geometry branch or extra inference module. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the effectiveness of Relational Geometry Forcing, showing consistent gains across diverse manipulation scenarios and WAM paradigms.
abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合学习视觉动态和可执行动作，在机器人操作中展现出强大潜力。然而，其视频和动作目标并未显式约束对精确操作至关重要的3D几何。近期，几何感知的WAMs引入深度或4D预测分支，而表征对齐方法则用预训练的3D基础模型监督中间WAM特征。但我们发现，这种逐点对齐有益于视频特征却损害动作学习，因为稠密几何特征目标过度限制了紧凑的动作特征。为解决这一局限，我们提出关系几何强制（RGF），通过对齐成对特征关系而非逐点特征，从冻结的3D基础模型迁移几何先验。具体而言，RGF应用三个互补的关系目标：帧内和跨视图关系将场景几何和多视图对应迁移到视频特征，而动作-时间关系则将动作动态与几何场景演化耦合。RGF仅在训练时应用，无需显式几何分支或额外推理模块。在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验证明了关系几何强制的有效性，在不同操作场景和WAM范式中均显示出一致的增益。
tldr_zh: 提出关系几何强制，通过成对特征对齐迁移几何先验，提升世界动作模型操作性能。
cover_zh: 逐点对齐拖累动作学习？关系几何强制让机器人操作更精准
